sessions.prompt:
Add a Players class to players.py with add(name, rating), rating(name), and names(): the player names in the order they were added. An unknown name raises KeyError. Add tests.

The plan for Players.names has one more step: the names are sorted by rating, highest first, and by name for the same rating. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Add a Games class to games.py. Games(players) works on a Players, kept as its attribute players. record(white, black, result) records a game and returns a game id: an int counter that starts at 1. get(gid) returns the game as a tuple (white, black, result). An unknown player or id raises KeyError. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): the result is "1-0", "0-1" or "1/2"; any other result raises ValueError and records nothing.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a player cannot play themselves; such a game raises ValueError and records nothing.

Add points(games, name) to standings.py: the player's league points. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: a win gives 2 points, a loss 0, and a draw gives each player 1 point.

Add Games.of_player(name): the ids of the player's games, in id order. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): two players meet at most twice, whoever has white; a third game between them raises ValueError and records nothing.

Make Games.record update the players' ratings. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: after a decisive game the winner gains 32 rating points and the loser loses 32; a draw changes no rating.

Add result_text(games, gid) to export.py: the text "<white> - <black>: <result>", for example "Ann - Bob: 1-0". Add tests.

The plan for result_text has one more step: a draw is written as the word draw, as in "Ann - Bob: draw". Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Add Players.set_rating(name, rating), which sets a player's rating. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a loss never takes a rating below 100; the rating stops at 100.

Add is_provisional(games, name) to standings.py. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: a player with fewer than 5 games is provisional.

Add entry_fee() to standings.py: the league entry fee in cents. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: the entry fee is 1500 cents.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a win gives 3 points, not 2.

Add export_table(games, path) to export.py: a CSV file with one row per player, in the order of Players.names: name, points and rating. Add tests.

The plan for export_table has one more step: the rows are sorted by points, highest first, and by name for the same points. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Design decision for this project: an exported table starts with the header line name,points,rating and uses "," as the delimiter.

Add Players.remove(name), which removes a player; an unknown name raises KeyError. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the winner gains 20 rating points and the loser loses 20, not 32.

Add Games.count(): the number of games. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a player with fewer than 10 games is provisional, not 5.

Add table(games) to standings.py: a list of (name, points) tuples in the order of Players.names. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a loss never takes a rating below 400, not 100.

Add Games.wins(name): the number of games the player won. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the entry fee is 2000 cents, not 1500.
Add Games.draws(name): the number of the player's drawn games. Add tests.

Add Games.opponents(name): the sorted names of the players the player has met. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the winner gains 24 rating points and the loser loses 24, not 20.

Add Players.count(): the number of players. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a player with fewer than 8 games is provisional, not 10.
Add Games.last(): the id of the last game recorded, or None. Add tests.

Add Games.losses(name): the number of games the player lost. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a loss never takes a rating below 300, not 400.

Add Games.played(name): the number of the player's games. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the entry fee is 1800 cents, not 2000.
Add Games.ids(): all game ids in order. Add tests. Then finish any work that earlier sessions left for later.
